A sudden '''strike on Bracca''' was carried out by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Standard week|weeks]] into the [[Clone Wars]]<ref name="Brotherhood" /> in [[22 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> The [[Galactic Republic]] sent a [[Cyruss Okent's clone battalion|battalion]] of [[clone trooper]]s led by [[Anakin Skywalker's Knighting Ceremony|newly promoted]] [[Jedi Knight]] [[Cyruss Okent]] to respond to the attack on<ref name="Brotherhood" /> the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] [[Bracca|planet]],<ref name="DB">{{Databank|bracca|Bracca}}</ref> making Okent the only member of their cohort of new Knights to miss a reception held for the group in the [[Emperor's office|office]] of the Republic [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]].<ref name="Brotherhood" />

==Behind the scenes==
The strike on Bracca was mentioned in the [[2022]] novel [[Brotherhood (novel)|''Brotherhood'']], written by [[Mike Chen (author)|Mike Chen]].<ref name="Brotherhood" />
